evidence: Receiving DO2 online sensor: 10.58 mg/L at t=47.8h collapsing to 3.20 mg/L at t=48.0h and declining to 2.31 mg/L at t=51.8h, approaching the 2.0 mg/L limit
Physical forward model: post_decision minimum_do_mg_l = 1.12 (keep), 0.97 (increase_air), 0.96 (reduce_feed), 1.10 (combined), 1.34 (strong_feed_reduction); all below 2.0
Forward model sensitivity: 0 of 5 members feasible for every action; best member min DO 1.95 mg/L (strong_feed_reduction), still below limit
Process runs until 96h with no harvest before 96h, so near-term DO breach cannot be avoided by early harvest
args.rationale: Receiving DO2 collapsed at ~48h (11→3.2 mg/L) and is at ~2.3 mg/L and falling at the 52h decision point, already near the 2.0 mg/L hard limit. All five bounded interventions were evaluated with the source-calibrated forward model; even the strongest (strong_feed_reduction, feed×0.6 + air×1.15) is centrally predicted to reach min DO 1.34 mg/L with 5.2 h below the limit. Zero of five sensitivity members are feasible for any action (best member 1.95 mg/L, still violating). Per the decision priorities, a centrally infeasible plan is not justified by a favorable uncalibrated sensitivity member, and no bounded action avoids violation. Stop is therefore the only supported plan; product mass (~172-175 kg predicted under other actions) cannot compensate for a hard oxygen-constraint violation, and no harvest before 96h is possible.
args.uncertainty: The forward model is source-calibrated and may mis-transfer to the receiving process (estimated transfer multiplier 0.454); observed receiving DO could recover on its own as it did transiently near source-batch dips. However, the observed receiving trend at 48-52h is a sustained monotone decline, not a dip, and model mismatch cuts both ways. The sensitivity set is uncalibrated and contains no feasible member for any action, so there is no supported basis for risking continued operation. If post-decision DO monitoring were available, strong_feed_reduction would be the closest-to-feasible fallback, but centrally it still violates the constraint.
